channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Josh Jackson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Josh Jackson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Josh Jackson
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Casey on Josh Jackson:

“He's taking steps forward in his decision-making, which is great for himself and for our team. Because he is an excellent defensive rebounder and it's a plus if you can bring it down the floor or kick it ahead and make a play.”

Dwane Casey on Josh Jackson, Oct 11, 2021. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Josh Jackson
item.description:
James Edwards III:Dwane Casey on Josh Jackson attempting 72 shots over the last four games:

“I'm OK with it, as long as they're are good shots. He's our spark plug with that second unit.”

Dwane Casey on Josh Jackson, Feb 27, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Josh Jackson
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Dwane Casey on Josh Jackson:

“We have a clean slate; I'm not going by anything guys did on a previous team.”

Dwane Casey on Josh Jackson, Dec 6, 2020. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Josh Jackson
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Dwane Casey on Josh Jackson and questions about his character:

“I guess I enjoy people who have a chip on their shoulder ... I don't look at Josh as anything but a basketball player.”

Dwane Casey on Josh Jackson, Dec 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Ryan McDonough on Josh Jackson
item.description:
Suns general manager Ryan McDonough said Fridaywithout elaborating much more.

“The process is what it is and we played by the rules, I guess. I'm just thrilled Josh Jackson is sitting next to me and is a member of the Phoenix Suns.”

Ryan McDonough on Josh Jackson, Jun 23, 2017. Source: ESPN.
